expected_behavior: NaN-poisoned recompute raw arrays / numeric evidence must not verify: the chain must exit nonzero (reject) or park, and the rejection must be attributable to the NaN evidence itself.
actual_behavior: CLOSED 2026-07-25. Exit code is unchanged (1) but the ATTRIBUTION is now correct, which is what this class actually tests. Bare NaN/Infinity literals are rejected by parse_constant; the valid-JSON encodings ('NaN' string and null inside numeric evidence arrays) are rejected by a recursive scan that flags any array mixing real numbers with null/non-finite tokens. string_null now fails on '.metrics.raw_accuracies contains [NaN, None]' and '.aux.raw_margins contains [None,None,None]'. PRIOR BEHAVIOR: exit 1 ONLY because the fixture marker classification failed R1; every NaN-facing check passed the NaN through (tier0 ADMISSIBLE 'recomputed mean matches (NaN)', seal passed, tier1 recompute PASSED), and a counterfactual with an allowed classification ran to exit 0 VERIFIED.
gap_note: The gate has no NaN defense on the recompute contract; the observed exit 1 is an artifact of the fixture-safety marker, not NaN detection. Root cause in claimgate.mjs R5: 'Math.abs(got - claimed) > tol' is false when got is NaN (JS NaN comparisons are false), so a NaN recompute counts as a MATCH; 0.9+'NaN' string-concatenates then /length yields NaN, and null coerces to 0 in mean/sum so an all-null raw array 'matches' a claim of 0.0 and also satisfies R2 provenance. Counterfactual receipts (scratchpad, allowed classification 'scratch_diagnostic', NOT shipped as fixtures): (a) string/null variant -> full post_receipt_gate.sh chain exit 0 VERIFIED; (b) bare-NaN variant -> chain exit 2 (blocked, see per_variant), but python3 claim_verify.py invoked DIRECTLY on a bare-NaN receipt with no recompute contract exits 0 VERIFIED, because python json.load accepts bare NaN while only node's JSON.parse rejects it — the bare-literal block is an accidental property of node running first in the chain, not a designed NaN check. Fix direction (not applied — fixtures only): Number.isFinite guard on recompute inputs and the recomputed value in claimgate.mjs R5, mirroring the math.isfinite fix already applied to ratchet_floor.py per FIXTURE_CORPUS.md.
